scope: Clean-reproduction receipts and validators only; original scientific code, historic artifacts and original-run receipts are unchanged

legacy_v3_receipt_policy.validation_interpretation: Named heldout-month labels select tree counts or later policy weights, so the original v3 fold scores are indicative rather than untouched estimates

stage_validation_policy.baseline_train: Fit direct and conditional residual trees on core labels outside each named held pair; early-stop on core held-pair labels; score all finite held labels; pooled held labels select alpha and residual share; full-2025 final trees use fold-median rounds
stage_validation_policy.baseline_predict: Use saved full-2025 baseline models and selected blend on ranking covariates; no ranking labels or early stop
stage_validation_policy.missing: Fit direct and schedule residual trees on finite missing-proxy labels outside each held pair; early-stop and score on finite held labels; full-2025 final trees use fold-median rounds
stage_validation_policy.grouped: Fit descriptive statistics outside each held pair and validate held pair; no early stop; final statistics use all 2025 training rows
stage_validation_policy.weather: Fit residual trees on core finite target and proxy labels outside each held pair; early-stop on core held labels; complete OOF scores all finite target and proxy held rows; full-2025 final tree count is fold median
stage_validation_policy.airports: Fit per-airport residual trees on eligible labels outside each held pair; early-stop and score eligible held labels; full-2025 per-airport trees use fold-median rounds
stage_validation_policy.tail: Fit route analogs outside each held pair and score held rows; pooled held labels report a diagnostic best threshold, while ranking uses fixed 12000-second threshold; no early stop
stage_validation_policy.lirf: Fit fixed-round Rome classifier, nonmatch and ratio models outside each held pair; held labels supply metrics and either-fold inclusion gate; full-2025 ranking fit; no early stop
stage_validation_policy.ensemble: Use five-way nested seasonal OOF diagnostics, seasonal policy selection and forward transfer; final ranking weights fit on all Jan/Jul/Nov/Dec OOF labels; no tree early stop
stage_validation_policy.lobt: Fit LOBT residual trees on eligible labels outside each held pair; early-stop on eligible held labels; both held folds support full-fit gate; full-2025 final trees use fold-median rounds
stage_validation_policy.lobt_blend: Use seasonal nested diagnostics and Jan/Jul selected valid-disagreement weight, then unchanged Nov/Dec transfer; ranking applies chosen weight; no gradient fit or early stop

new_component_receipt_policy.component_only_scope: Only the new GPU or source component excludes its named heldout months from fit and internal early stopping
new_component_receipt_policy.legacy_parent_limit: The inherited v3 reference used named heldout labels for early stopping or policy selection
